name: World Cup
description: FIFA World Cup 2026 companion: live scores, schedule, group standings, knockout bracket, followed-team match reminders, and AI tools.
author: Asyar

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API-Football API key
preferences.description: Free key from dashboard.api-football.com (api-sports.io). Free plan allows ~100 requests/day.

preferences.name: season
preferences.title: Tournament season (year)
preferences.description: World Cup edition year. Note: API-Football's FREE plan only covers 2022–2024 — set 2022 (Qatar) to demo on a free key; 2026 needs a paid plan.

preferences.name: notifyGoals
preferences.title: Goal alerts for my followed team

commands.name: Follow a Team
commands.description: Pick the team you want reminders for

commands.name: World Cup Tick
commands.description: Background check that fires match reminders and goal alerts

tools.name: World Cup matches today
tools.description: List the FIFA World Cup matches scheduled for today, with kickoff times and live scores. Call when the user asks what World Cup games are on today or right now.

tools.name: World Cup team fixtures
tools.description: Get a team's World Cup fixtures and results. Call when the user asks when a specific country plays next or how they have done.

tools.name: World Cup standings
tools.description: Get World Cup group standings. Call when the user asks about a group table or how a group is shaping up.

group.description: Optional group letter, e.g. 'A' or 'Group C'. Omit for all groups.

tools.name: World Cup match score
tools.description: Get the current score/status of a World Cup match by team name. Call when the user asks the score of a specific game.

team.description: A team in the match, e.g. 'England'.

tools.name: Next match for followed team
tools.description: Get the next fixture for the team the user is following in the World Cup extension. Call when the user asks 'when does my team play next'.
